messages:
Leah (Customer): Hey team — since last night a subset of our /v1/embeddings calls started erroring only when we tag requests as high priority. Regular requests (no priority header) are fine. Error: 400 dimension mismatch. Help?
Jordan (Support): @Leah thanks — can you paste a minimal repro (curl + headers) and an example error payload? Also which model and embedding dim?
Leah (Customer): model: text-embed-001, expected_dim: 1536. Repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'X-Request-Priority: high' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"text-embed-001","input":["a","b"]}'` -> response: `{"error":"dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1535"}`
Jordan (Support): hmm interesting that priority header changes behavior. @DeployBot do we have any routing/pool rules for priority? :thinking_face:
DeployBot: Routing rule: priority=high -> dedicated pool 'high-priority-routed' (policy: low-latency, dynamic-batching enabled, max_batch_size=8, early-drain=100ms).
Jordan (Support): tagging that info. @Sam could this be a batching/coalescer issue? The same payload with no header -> OK. With header -> dimension mismatch.
Sam (Eng - Runtime): Thanks. A couple quick Qs: 1) Do you see the error only for multi-input batches or single-input requests too? 2) Any chance one of the inputs is an empty string?
Leah (Customer): Only when we send 2+ inputs. Single input fine. No empty strings. We tried reordering inputs and saw it fail sometimes.
Kevin (SRE): Upload logs please (request ids + timestamps). If it's routed to different pool the runtime config might be different and causing a pad/truncate bug.
Leah (Customer): Pasted two request ids: req_20241110_01 and req_20241110_02. Both have same payload but one succeeds, one fails even though both were high priority.
Jordan (Support): Reproduced locally with a quick script by forcing header -> I can see intermittent failure. Stack trace snippet from failed call: `RuntimeError: tensor concat mismatch: shape [1536] vs [1535] at batch_aggregator.cpp:243`.
Sam (Eng - Runtime): That stack points at batching coalescer. Theory: high-priority pool uses an optimized model variant (quantized) with 1536 dim, but under dynamic batching we sometimes mix requests that were pinned to a different variant (1535 due to a buggy variant metadata). Mixing variants should be prevented — looks like a routing/tagging race when requests get rebalanced across workers during early-drain.
Jordan (Support): Is there a quick mitigation we can suggest to the customer?
Sam (Eng - Runtime): Workarounds: 1) remove X-Request-Priority (routes to default pool) 2) set header `X-Disable-Batching: true` to force non-batched path for high-priority (temporary) 3) configure `max_batch_size` lower on high-priority pool to avoid mixing partial drains (but that's a config band-aid). Recommend 2 for lowest impact.
Leah (Customer): We can try `X-Disable-Batching` — will that significantly increase token cost/latency?
Sam (Eng - Runtime): Latency for small requests will be slightly higher but stable. Costs small increase because you lose batching efficiency. For p95-critical traffic, it's acceptable as temporary mitigation.
Kevin (SRE): I've opened INC-2026-443 (runtime-batcher-priority-variant-race). Action items: capture full binary logs from high-priority pool, add extra assertions to batcher to avoid mixing model variants, and revert early-drain behavior until fix lands. Rolling patch ETA 4 hours for a hotfix and a config rollback if needed.
Jordan (Support): I'll tell the customer recommended steps: apply `X-Disable-Batching: true` for high-priority until we push hotfix; share INC ticket and ETA; request logs for both req ids.
Leah (Customer): Thanks. Applying `X-Disable-Batching` now... ok first test succeeded (no error). Applying to prod for next hour. Appreciate the quick triage :pray:
Sam (Eng - Runtime): Good sign. We'll prioritize the hotfix. I'll post a follow-up once we have the patch.
Kevin (SRE): Patch plan: 1) add variant-id check in coalescer, 2) add pad-to-max-dim guard 3) monitor for any fallback to default pool. Will roll with canary to 10% high-priority traffic.
Jordan (Support): Noted. Leah — leaving this thread open until patch is deployed. I'll update every 30m or on major milestone.
Leah (Customer): Thanks Jordan. Appreciate the canary plan and the workaround.
Sam (Eng - Runtime): Quick raw repro script for internal use (shell):
```
for i in {1..20}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'X-Request-Priority: high' \
    -H 'X-Client-Id: test-client' \
    -d '{"model":"text-embed-001","input":["foo","bar"]}' &
done; wait
```
Use that to reproduce the intermittent failure locally.
Jordan (Support): Thanks. Adding logs to ticket INC-2026-443 and notifying account team. :eyes:
Kevin (SRE): I'll post patch link once CI passes.
Sam (Eng - Runtime): If anyone hits this and needs an immediate toggle, we can temporarily set `high-priority-routed` pool's `dynamic_batching.enabled=false` from the control plane — requires ops signoff.
Jordan (Support): Ops, can you stand by to flip if needed?
Kevin (SRE): Standby acknowledged.
Leah (Customer): Confirmed stable after disabling batching. I'll wait for your patch before removing the header.
Jordan (Support): Closing loop once patch is in prod. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
